1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder __selected from the group consisting of thermally conductive epoxy and materials having thermal conductivity greater than 1 W/m·K__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __in a layer having a thickness of less than 100 micrometers__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __by heating to a temperature sufficient to vaporize the solvent without melting the binder__.
